NEWS ITEM-It is understood that MARSHAL FOSH has been appointed by the "Big Four" to meet Mathias Erzberger at Spa and discuss the question of Danzig and the landing of a Polish army. Danzig is situated about 150 miles from the Russian border and is the capital of the province of West Prussia one of the oldest German cities. While Danzig is a great city for the grain and wheat industry one of the main thoroughfares is shown above namely, the Langgasse.
